appraisal_events.evidence: Le duc le regarda, le reconnut, se vit perdu ... l'huissier hurlait ... Son Altesse Monseigneur le duc de Châtellerault !
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator frames the usher's forced, booming revelation of an identity the duke had tried to keep hidden as a moment of personal exposure the duke himself experiences as ruinous ('se vit perdu'), even though the announcement formally restores his full title.

appraisal_events.evidence: au lieu de rester assise comme pour les autres invités, elle se leva, vint à moi... La princesse venait de me tendre la main en souriant.
appraisal_events.explanation: After a long buildup of dread about being announced as an unwanted intruder, the princess breaks with how she treats every other guest to rise and personally greet the narrator with a smile, marking him out as included and welcome.

status_effects.explanation: He suffers a jolt of alarm at seeing his concealed identity publicly disclosed, momentarily feeling himself exposed and lost.
The princess's exceptional, protocol-breaking gesture of rising to greet him personally resolves his fear of exclusion and marks him as distinctly welcomed.
